title: Apple (AAPL) Given a $175.00 Price Target at Nomura
text:
Tweet 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) received a $175.00 price objective from stock analysts at Nomura in a report released on Wednesday. The firm presently has a “neutral” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. Nomura’s price objective points to a potential upside of 4.30% from the company’s previous close. 
A number of other research analysts have also recently issued reports on the stock. Vetr raised shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $177.17 price target for the company in a report on Wednesday, November 29th. UBS set a $190.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, December 4th. Tigress Financial reaffirmed a “strong-buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, December 6th. KeyCorp reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $192.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, December 7th. Finally, Stifel Nicolaus reaffirmed a “sell” rating and issued a $26.00 price target (up previously from $22.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, December 13th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $202.62. Get Apple alerts: 
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $167.78 on Wednesday. The company has a market capitalization of $854,159.38, a price-to-earnings ratio of 17.24, a PEG ratio of 1.28 and a beta of 1.19. Apple has a twelve month low of $140.06 and a twelve month high of $183.50. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. Apple’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period last year, the firm earned $3.36 earnings per share. equities analysts predict that Apple will post 11.37 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
In related news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at $2,401,302.42. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this hyperlink . Insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.
